title: Juicebox pricing - $139/seat/month, AI Agents add-on pushes effective cost near $400
clean_text: Juicebox pricing starts at $139 per seat per month, but add-ons such as AI Agents ($199/month) push the real effective cost near $400/month before a single hire is closed. The Starter plan excludes phone numbers and verified emails, meaning teams hit a wall when they try to actually contact candidates and must upgrade to reach them.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-seat plus AI add-on
